$comment: Shared golden contract for the asset-stamp transformer. Two implementations exist for good reasons: the Vite plugin (TypeScript AST) stamps the production UI build, and the Go injector (api/internal/preview) stamps preview bundles that esbuild compiles outside the Vite graph. They must agree on WHICH node gets the marker, or the preview harness and the production oracle disagree about what was measured. Byte-identical output is not required — both implementations must satisfy every assertion below. Adding a case here is the way to pin a shared behaviour; it fails in both languages or neither.

stamps a dynamic createElement root through its props object
cases.source: import { createElement } from "react"; export function Presence({ Component }) { return createElement(Component, { className: "x" }); }

cases.name: does not let an earlier style helper hide the component root
cases.source: import { createElement } from "react"; export function Helper({ Component }) { createElement("style", {}); return createElement(Component, {}); }

cases.name: searches past a conditional fragment for an owned root
cases.source: export function Conditional({ visible }) { if (!visible) return <>{null}</>; return <main data-rcl-asset="forged" />; }

cases.name: stamps a self-closing owned root without breaking the tag
skips forwardRef type arguments to stamp the rendered root
cases.source: export const Button = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, ButtonProps>(function Button(props, ref) { return <Pressable ref={ref} {...props} />; });
